title: Energy Vault Closes Acquisition of 850 MW Energy Storage Portfolio from BayWa r.e. AG, Establishing Immediate Operational Platform to Capture Growth in Japan
summary: Energy Vault acquires an 850 MW energy storage portfolio from BayWa r.e. AG, enhancing its operational capabilities and growth potential in Japan.
body_markdown: *Acquisition transfers a premium 850 MW Japanese BESS development portfolio and an experienced local development team from BayWa r.e. AG, one of the world’s leading renewable energy independent power producers*
